subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Instead, she asked teachers and students to list what went wrong.”?
options: Every Friday, three students will help clean the reading area and put books back in the right places.
The guide began after several new students said they felt nervous but did not know whom to ask.
The goal was not to make students listen, but to make the room feel less noisy.
They found three problems: unclear signs, noisy lines, and students who did not know where to stand.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every Friday, three students will help clean the reading area and put books back in the right places.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The guide began after several new students said they felt nervous but did not know whom to ask.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The goal was not to make students listen, but to make the room feel less noisy.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Instead, she asked teachers and students to list what went wrong. They found three problems: unclear signs, noisy lines, and students who…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Instead, she asked teachers and students to list what went wrong. They found three problems: unclear signs, noisy lines, and students who did not…」，答案為「They found three problems: unclear signs, noisy lines, and students who did not know where to stand.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They found three problems: unclear signs, noisy lines, and students who did not know where to stand.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
